title: New Medicaid Managed Care Membership Onboarding: Coverage Start, Welcome Call and Health Risk Assessment
content:
## Onboarding standard

**Standard.** A Medicaid Managed Care Membership opens in pending status on the enrollment date and becomes active on the coverage start date. The state may set the coverage start date up to the category's retroactive coverage months calendar months before the application month, and never earlier than the application month in a category whose retroactive coverage months are zero. Prairie Ridge places the welcome call within the category's welcome call days and offers the health risk assessment within the category's health risk assessment days, both counted in calendar days from the coverage start date, or from the activation day when the coverage start date lies in the past. A member who paid a provider out of pocket for a covered service with a service date inside retroactive coverage may ask for reimbursement within the category's reimbursement filing days after the service date; such reimbursements are handled by the claims unit and are not booked as member cost share.

### The dates at a glance

| Item | Counted from | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Pending status | Enrollment date | Until the coverage start date |
| Active status | Coverage start date | — |
| Retroactive coverage start | Application month | Up to the category's retroactive coverage months before it (none where that figure is zero) |
| Welcome call | Coverage start date, or the activation day when the coverage start date lies in the past | Category's welcome call days |
| Health risk assessment offered | Same starting day as the welcome call | Category's health risk assessment days |
| Out-of-pocket reimbursement request | Service date inside retroactive coverage | Category's reimbursement filing days |

### Hypothetical timeline

Hypothetical inputs only: a category with 3 retroactive coverage months, 30 welcome call days and 90 health risk assessment days; an application in June.

- The state may set the coverage start date as early as 1 March, three calendar months before June.
- If the coverage start date is 1 March and the membership is activated on 12 June, the start date lies in the past, so the welcome call and health risk assessment clocks run from 12 June: the welcome call is placed within 30 calendar days and the assessment offered within 90 calendar days of that day.
- A visit on 20 April that the member paid for out of pocket falls inside retroactive coverage; the member may ask the claims unit for reimbursement within the category's reimbursement filing days after 20 April, and the reimbursement is not booked as member cost share.
